archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Performance Pro (Archetypes 4 & 2)
design_vision: Cinematic, tactical, pro-creator tool. Inspired by CapCut, Linear, and Notion. Uses pure function-first UI for the editor, contrasted with a cinematic, highly-polished marketing presence. NO generic AI slop. NO purple/violet gradients. Deep obsidian space, accented strictly by Cyber Yellow and pure white.

layout_and_spacing.marketing: Asymmetric bento grids, massive padding (p-16 to p-32).
layout_and_spacing.editor: Strict Control Room layout. 100vh locked. Flexbox / Grid combo with zero wasted space. Sub-panels use p-2 or p-4.

surface_strategies.editor_panels: Flat solid #121212 with 1px border_subtle. No shadows. Sharp corners or very subtle rounded-sm.
surface_strategies.viral_mode_btn: Retro-Futurism: bg-transparent, border-[#FFD60A], text-[#FFD60A], drop-shadow glow on hover.

landing.layout: Hero centered with heavy text, overlaying abstract dark bg. Bento grid below for features.
landing.key_elements: Hero BG, massive H1, 'Start Creating' CTA in Cyber Yellow.

auth.layout: Centered Glassmorphic card on deep charcoal noise background.
auth.key_elements: Social logins, minimal form, no distracting graphics.

projects_dashboard.layout: Top header with user avatar, 'New Project' dominant CTA. Grid of project cards below.
projects_dashboard.key_elements: Thumbnail images, project title, last edited relative time.

ai_studio_wizard.layout: 2-column split. Left: Script input (textarea). Right: AI generation status & real-time visual preview.

editor.layout: Grid template areas. Top Nav (H: 48px). Left Sidebar (W: 280px, Asset Library). Center Top (Preview Canvas). Right Sidebar (W: 280px, Inspector/Properties). Bottom (H: 40%, Timeline).
editor.key_elements: Playhead (yellow absolute line), multi-track timeline, draggable clips, inspector tabs (Video, Audio, Captions, Effects).

render_queue_export.key_elements: Large JetBrains Mono percentage, sleek yellow progress bar, terminal-like render logs.

motion_and_interactions.timeline: Smooth horizontal scrolling. Draggable clips need 'grabbing' cursor.
motion_and_interactions.modals: Fade in with slight scale up (Framer Motion).

components.buttons: Shadcn based. Primary: bg-[#FFD60A] text-black hover:bg-[#F0C808]. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/5.
components.inputs: bg-[#070707] border-white/10 focus:border-[#FFD60A] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FFD60A]/50 text-white rounded-md
components.tabs: Cardless tabs. Underline active indicator in #FFD60A, text turns white.
components.slider: Shadcn slider, track is white/20, active is #FFD60A, thumb is white.

media_assets.description: Man adjusting a professional video camera

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Use Text Shadow on canvas overlays.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='viral-mode-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Add Google Fonts CDN in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap');
Configure tailwind.config.js to extend these font families ('Cabinet Grotesk', 'Satoshi', 'JetBrains Mono').
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn components heavily customized to match the dark theme.
Prioritize performance. Timeline needs to be built with raw divs + Tailwind for rendering speed.
Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for dense UI tools like the editor.
Make sure the timeline playhead is absolute positioned with z-index above tracks.
Build the 'Viral Mode' button using Retro-Futurism styling: neon yellow borders, glowing drop-shadow.
